app.title: Japanese Names · IME Phrases

tip.binding: How names map to IME codes: manual / manual(global) / QWERTY key order (24) / QWERTY flow order (12)
tip.bindManualGlobal: Uses global default bindings (__global__) as code source; no per-row entry needed. Rows without global bindings will be left empty
tip.globalCodeReadOnly: This code comes from global default bindings (read-only). Manage via Settings → Save batch bindings as global
tip.bindManualDetail: Manual mode: enter pinyin code per row (e.g. q, sakura), each row independent. No count limit, ideal for precise control over each name's IME code. Empty rows will be imported with blank codes
tip.orderMode: Fixed: all phrases use the same candidate position (editable when fixed); Auto: detect same-code+same-position conflicts at import and auto +1
tip.orderValue: Candidate window position in fixed mode; larger = further back
tip.count: Number of names to write in this import
tip.import: Write the first N names of the current batch into Microsoft Pinyin user-defined phrases
tip.clear: Remove all user-defined phrases from the Microsoft Pinyin lexicon (undo available)
tip.undo: Undo the last import or clear operation
tip.hideStatus: Hide the bottom status bar (it reappears on new messages)
tip.globalSave: Save the current batch's manual bindings as global defaults, applied when a batch has no manual entry

This will erase ALL custom phrases in the Microsoft Pinyin lexicon!

A backup is taken before the operation and can be restored via Undo.

OK to clear; Cancel to abort.
dialog.configError.title: Config Files Corrupted
dialog.configError.desc: The following config files are corrupted or unparsable. They were skipped and defaults are used. You can isolate them (rename to _error_+timestamp) and reload with defaults.
msg.configIsolated: Isolated {n} corrupted config files; reloaded with defaults
msg.configIsolateFail: {n} config files failed to isolate (may be read-only, e.g. language packs); please reinstall
act.fetch.tip: Call window.api.capture() (falls back to window.__appActions.capture() when window.api is unavailable) to trigger Fetch: scrape a batch of Japanese names from namechef and store them in the current batch. Identical to pressing Alt+X.
act.import.tip: Call window.api.doImport() (or window.__appActions.doImport()) to trigger One-click Import: write the first N names of the current batch into the IME custom phrases using the selected binding. Same as pressing Alt+V.
act.clear.tip: Call window.api.doClear() (or window.__appActions.doClear()) to trigger One-click Clear: remove all custom phrases from the IME dictionary. Same as Alt+C; undoable via Undo.
act.undo.tip: Call window.api.doUndo() (or window.__appActions.doUndo()) to trigger Undo: revert the last import or clear operation. Same as pressing Alt+Z.
act.toggleField.tip: Call window.api.togglePhraseField() (or window.__appActions.togglePhraseField()) to trigger Toggle Phrase Field: cycle the current phrase field among Kanji / Romaji / Hiragana. Same as pressing Alt+B.
